subject: Your dog's 68-day transformation photos
preview_text: Thank you for sticking with PupShape. Here's something only you get as a long-term user.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago, you decided to change your dog's life. Today, I want to say thank you. Not a generic email thank you, but a real one. You've been through the meal plan tweaks, the treat swaps, the first weight milestone celebration. You stuck with it when it got tough. That matters.

Here's what most users never see: The exact before-and-after timeline we built for long-term members like you. It's not just photos. It's a breakdown of every pound lost, every extra minute of play, every vet visit dodged. You've earned this insider view because you didn't quit.

Open the app and look for the hidden 'Legacy Timeline' feature. It's tucked under your progress tracker, visible only to users who've been with us 8+ weeks. Your dog's journey is in there, mapped out with milestones your vet would be proud of. No ads, no upsells. Just your hard work, laid out.
Swipe through your dog's transformation now. See how far they've come. P.S. This timeline autoupdates every week—so you'll never miss a win, big or small.
